name: VIM-MMMU
description: VIM-MMMU is a multimodal benchmark designed to evaluate models' ability to understand and follow multimodal (vision + language) instructions across varied tasks and scenarios. It emphasizes alignment between visual inputs and user instructions and measures model competence on instruction following and visual reasoning.
reputation: An emerging multimodal benchmark with growing interest in vision-and-language research, though not yet as widely adopted as larger established vision or language benchmarks.
